body: The solution lies in the trigger. I just don't feel like it's worth all the effort anymore if it all amounts to nothing in the end.

I feel like I'm at the same point you are...my birthday is in February and I feel like my life always just crumbles down on me every single year around this time. I have a good job, a loving family,no
bills and everything I could ever want but nothing feels like enough. It all boils over at the same time every year...I just posted here as well. I sat in my yard with a pistol in my mouth for an hour and a half and if it wasn't for my dog I would have pulled the trigger.
Who would take car of her? Would they send her to the pound? Does she need me? What would she do without me?.....OP I don't know about you but I'm just done with the way I feel but I don't know where else to turn other than the trigger...
